about: Note-trigger probes for D-56 (G2 fix design, sections 4.3 and 4.5). Written by the build session for these tests, in its own words, after the five missed notes of G2 decision run 1 were known; not taken from any adversarial set. Probes that should fire must show every label in 'expect'; near misses must show no scope, other-Act or DQ-12 note. Matched on the question alone (no retrieval). Because they were written with the patterns in view, they check that the families work as intended; they are not a held-out measure.
